snippet.title: Outbound - Official Dev Diary: Crafting and Resourcing Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Join developer Square Glade Games for a closer look at the crafting, building, and resourcing system of Outbound in this latest video for the upcoming cozy open-world exploration game. Outbound will be available on PC via Steam, Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation 5. 


In Outbound, build your own home on wheels and live sustainably off-grid. Craft workstations and power supplies, source energy from the sun, wind, or water, upgrade and customize your vehicle, grow crops, and explore a colorful world with up to 4 players.
